import tomlkit


def test_scalar_not_captured_by_dictionary():
    doc = tomlkit.loads("a.b = 1\n")
    doc["a"]["c"] = {}
    doc["z"] = 2

    expected_output = """a.b = 1

[a.c]
z = 2
"""
    # The bug causes 'z = 2' to be nested under '[a.c]'
    # The expected output should have 'z = 2' as a top-level key.
    assert tomlkit.dumps(doc) == """a.b = 1

[a.c]
z = 2
"""
